{{Top|leg}}
A '''beam gem''' was a hard to come by crystal that was usually found in [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. They came in at least two sizes, designated size 4 and 5. Wedging three into the barrel of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and altering the weapon's [[galven pattern]] allowed an individual to create a crude [[Beam splitter/Legends|beam splitter]].<ref name="CR">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>
